name: Dickinson
description: Emily Dickinson. Poet. Daughter. Total rebel. In this coming-of-age story, Emily’s determined to become the world's greatest poet.

videos.title: From Dickinson With Love
videos.overview: Join Hailee Steinfeld and the cast and crew of Dickinson as they take us behind-the-scenes on set, reminisce on their favorite memories together, and say farewell after three incredible seasons.

videos.title: Because I could not stop
videos.overview: Emily's attempt to publish a poem sparks backlash.

videos.title: I have never seen ‘Volcanoes’
videos.overview: Women are forbidden at Amherst, so Emily and Sue get creative to attend a lecture.

videos.title: Wild nights
videos.overview: Emily and Austin throw a party, and their mutual love for Sue causes tension.

videos.title: Alone, I cannot be
videos.overview: Emily seeks help from an author when her favorite tree is threatened.

videos.title: I am afraid to own a Body
videos.overview: Emily confronts tough issues at a meeting of the local Shakespeare Club.

videos.title: A brief, but patient illness
videos.overview: Emily takes a “sick day” to write and finds a connection with her father's law clerk.

videos.title: We lose - because we win
videos.overview: On her father's election day, Emily defiantly attempts to publish another poem.

videos.title: There’s a certain Slant of light
videos.overview: On Christmas, Emily tries to be the “good little woman.” Zosia Mamet guest stars.

videos.title: ‘Faith’ is a fine invention
videos.overview: During a solar eclipse, Emily confronts the Shadow of Death in her home.

videos.title: I felt a Funeral, in my Brain
videos.overview: Emily’s relationships are challenged as she moves into a new chapter of life.

videos.title: Before I got my eye put out
videos.overview: Emily's insular poetic world is rocked when Sue introduces her to Sam Bowles, a newspaper editor with a strong interest in publishing women.

videos.title: Fame is a fickle food
videos.overview: Her participation in an Amherst baking contest gives Emily a taste of fame and celebrity, but she questions the benefits.

videos.title: The only Ghost I ever saw
videos.overview: Torn about whether to allow Sam to publish her work, Emily hosts a séance in search of guidance.

videos.title: The Daisy follows soft the Sun
videos.overview: After some time without news from Sam, Emily begins to suffer from writer's block. To rediscover her inspiration, she ventures into the landscape.

videos.title: Forbidden Fruit a flavor has
videos.overview: When she learns that Sam plans to publish her poem, Emily embraces being his latest discovery while attending one of Sue's salons.

videos.title: Split the lark
videos.overview: Things don't go as planned when Emily tries to express her gratitude to Sam during a night at the opera.

videos.title: Forever - is composed of Nows
videos.overview: Thinking she's blown her shot at publication, Emily spirals into depression. Her mother attempts to help her with a trip to the water cure.

videos.title: I'm Nobody! Who are you?
videos.overview: When her poem is finally published in Sam's newspaper, Emily is shocked to discover that she has become invisible to the world.

videos.title: I Like a Look of Agony
videos.overview: To distract himself from the pain of life, Austin throws a tea party for his old college friends—but the day is disrupted by a major political event.

videos.title: You cannot put a Fire out
videos.overview: While the whole town attends the christening of Jane's baby, Emily fights to get her poems back from Sam.

videos.title: “Hope” is the thing with feathers
videos.overview: Amid the Civil War's mounting casualties, the Dickinsons grieve one of their own—and Emily struggles to keep the peace in her family.

videos.title: It feels a shame to be Alive -
videos.overview: Frazar Stearns leaves to meet his fate on the battlefield just as the Dickinson family welcomes a new life.

videos.title: The Soul has Bandaged moments
videos.overview: Determined to heal the nation, Emily and Lavinia host a sewing circle to support the troops with help from Amherst's finest seamstress, Betty.

videos.title: This is my letter to the World
videos.overview: Emily tries to connect with the pain of war by writing to a Union Army colonel and visiting a war hospital. Henry takes a new job teaching soldiers.

videos.title: Sang from the Heart, Sire
videos.overview: Emily tries to celebrate her father’s birthday with an old-fashioned family singalong, but it devolves into another battle in the Dickinsons’ own civil war.

videos.title: A little Madness in the Spring
videos.overview: The Dickinsons take a fun family outing to an asylum. Henry helps the soldiers with a uniform inspection.

videos.title: The Future never spoke
videos.overview: After a clash with Sue, Emily wishes she could escape from this troubled time altogether. Austin struggles with a man's responsibility in wartime.

videos.title: My Life had stood – a Loaded Gun -
videos.overview: On the day of a soldier's memorial, Emily's efforts to keep her family's hope alive reach a breaking point and she descends into a personal inferno.

videos.title: Grief is a Mouse
videos.overview: Emily takes steps to ensure that her family won't repeat their past mistakes. The Amherst gang gathers for a fond farewell.

videos.title: This was a Poet -
videos.overview: Emily asks Betty to help her design a new dress. The Dickinson family is surprised by an unexpected guest.
